comparison.objective: Candidate rejects open cartons from a moving belt while closed cartons pass; PR-2049 locks a needle sheath and disposes of the syringe.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic carton interception, flap-safe body support, and spill-free transport versus one-handed hinged-sheath actuation and hazardous-point avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires tray release/dwell, retained contents, no drop, and untouched downstream passage of closed cartons; PR-2049 requires a positively locked sheath, covered needle, released syringe in the sharps tray, and no unsafe needle proximity/contact.
comparison.reason: The manipulated mechanisms, hazards, and tested control abilities are unrelated. Candidate flap-clearance details lack a numeric collision threshold, but that omission does not create plausible duplication.
